  "name": "Heritage signboard",
  "tags": [
    "heritage",

  "concept": "Old-quarter shop signboards: lacquer-red boards with gold-leaf lettering on aged paper; ink-black text; serif display set large like carved characters.",
  "rationale": [
    "Accent = ink (giay-900), not lacquer red: red is the error hue; an ink button keeps the primary action calm and lets red mean 'signboard' (brand surfaces) instead of 'danger'.",
    "Neutrals are tinted toward paper (hue 80) at the same temperature as the gold, so paper, ink and gold read as one material family.",
    "Display scale 30/42/60/85 at √2 ratio: carved-signboard titles need big jumps; UI text stays at a calm 1.2 ratio.",

      "chroma": 0.15

      "hue": 82,

    "brandStep": 800,
    "onBrandSignature": true,
    "signatureStep": 500
  },
  "type": {
    "base": 16,
    "ratio": 1.2,
    "displayRatio": 1.414
  },
  "fits": [
    "heritage retail",
    "jewellery, tea, crafts",
    "culture and tourism",
    "premium F&B"
  ],
  "avoid": [
    "dense back-office tools",
    "products that must feel neutral"
  ],
  "layout": "Desktop 12 columns, content 1200, gutters 24, generous top whitespace above display titles; mobile 2-column product grid, margins 16.",
  "components": [
    "Buttons 14/600, radius 2-4: ink primary, outline secondary; lacquer only on brand bands with gold text.",
    "Eyebrow caps 12/600 tracking 0.16em above display titles (ink on paper; gold only on lacquer).",
    "Product names in display serif 22, exactly two lines.",
    "Price in display serif, never \"0 ₫\" (show \"Liên hệ\")."
  ],
  "do": [
    "Set display titles big (42-85) and let them breathe.",
    "Use gold only as ornament and thin rules.",
    "Use real product photography on paper backgrounds."
  ],
  "dont": [
    "Gold text on paper below 18px.",
    "Gradients, glass, glows.",
    "More than one framed signboard block per view."
  ],
  "motifs": [
    {
      "name": "signboard-frame",
      "use": "Hero blocks and brand panels: double frame (gold inner rule inside a lacquer board). One per screen."
    },
    {
      "name": "gold-rule",
      "use": "Section dividers: short gold rule with a centred diamond. Never under every heading."
    }
  ],
  "roles": {

    "brand": "son-800",
    "on-brand": "kim-100",
    "signature": "kim-500"
  },
  "contrasts": [
    {
      "fg": "ink",
      "bg": "surface",
      "ratio": 14.81
    },
    {
      "fg": "muted",
      "bg": "surface",
      "ratio": 8.49
    },
    {
      "fg": "accent",
      "bg": "surface",
      "ratio": 11.41

    }
  ],

    "display": "Noto Serif Display",

    "mono": "JetBrains Mono",
